text:
Snow lies in the fields,
and the valleys are frozen;
deep midnight
hangs darkly over the world.
Yet a glimpse of light on the peaks
reveals profane feasts of old.

Death is in the clouds,
fear is in the night,
for the dead in their shrouds
celebrate the setting sun,
singing wild songs in the woods as they dance
around Yule’s moldy white altar.

A wind from beyond this world
moves through the oak forest,
whose morbid branches drown
in a tangle of delirious mistletoe,
for these are the powers of darkness that endure
in the tombs of the lost race of Druids.

translation.title: The Yule Horror
